This is a demonstration unit. Every person, act and signal in it is made up, so you can see what a unit's page looks like after a month of meetings.

Someone signalled pain.

  • Sep 30, 2026 “We talked for two hours and did nothing.”

Pain signals are shown without names and remain in the record.

Scroll right, toward the future.

Horizons

Futures this unit wants. Under each are the things it asks of the present, with the unit’s own forecast that each will happen and how far that forecast has moved.

A town where nobody eats alone

written by ada, bensince Sep 12, 2026

Every evening there is a table somewhere with a free seat and food on it, and everyone knows where to find it.
Nobody has to ask.

  • A weekly shared meal anyone can find 48% +33
  • Ten households that cook for more than themselves 18% +12

Our block grows a third of its own food

written by cysince Sep 12, 2026

Front lawns are gardens. What we can’t eat moves through a shelf on the corner that anyone can stock or take from.

  • A map of every unused yard on the block 65% +35
  • Three neighbours who can start seeds 45% +25
  • A corner shelf people restock 43% +20

Scores

Instructions anyone can carry out with someone else. An act usually starts from one.

the future teaches the present

Imagine a future worth living in. Find one thing it would require of the present. Do that with someone.

adopted from recursion.kernel

recursive world

Gather a few people. Name something you depend on together. Make one small change that helps you care for it.

adopted from recursion.kernel

stream

Pass on something that helped you. Leave room for the next person to change it.

adopted from recursion.kernel

Protocol

Recorded since the founding. To change these texts through the kernel, a proposal needs 75% yes, with at least 50% of members voting. Each build checks the texts against the recorded lock.

How we meet

Demo text, standing in for a meeting format a real unit writes itself.

We meet weekly. Someone brings a score; we do it together. Afterwards everyone signals how it felt and whether it moved anything.

Traditions

Demo text, standing in for traditions a real unit writes itself.

  1. Every member was met in person by someone already here.
  2. Any unit can fork; the fork owes us nothing.

Proposals

  • Plan only while making TRADITIONS.md open, 2 yes and 0 no of 5
  • Raise the bar for changing the rules governance ratified (4-1 of 5)

Founded Sep 12, 2026 by ada, ben, cy. p-001 ratified Oct 21, 2026, 4–1.

Compiled by the recursion kernel on Oct 21, 2026. Built from the unit’s files.

To start a unit of your own, fork this unit’s repository and run node kernel.mjs fork <name> --yes. Horizons, scores and protocol come with you. Members don’t: everyone in a unit was met in person by someone already in it.
